lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Several lines located on the anterior shoulder and posterior flank terminate mid-torso, appearing as abbreviated segments rather than full vertical traversals.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white horizontal marking on the cheek area; distinct white transversal bands on the upper segments of the forelimbs and hind limbs.
